title: New Study Claims COVID Vaccine Causes Widespread Heart Problems

claims.text: The COVID-19 vaccine causes myocarditis in 1 in 1000 young people.
claims.explanation: This claim is false. The actual rate of myocarditis after vaccination is extremely rare (approximately 1 in 50,000) and usually mild.

claims.text: Thousands of people have died from COVID-19 vaccine side effects.
claims.explanation: False. All vaccine-related deaths are thoroughly investigated, and no causal link has been found in the vast majority of cases.

claims.text: Vaccines don't prevent transmission of the virus.
claims.explanation: Partially true. Vaccines reduce transmission significantly but don't completely eliminate it.

claims.text: The vaccines were developed too quickly and weren't properly tested.
claims.explanation: False. The vaccines underwent rigorous clinical trials and safety reviews. The speed was due to unprecedented global cooperation and funding.

claims.text: mRNA vaccines have been studied for over a decade before COVID-19.
claims.explanation: True. mRNA technology has been researched for over 20 years, including for cancer and other diseases.

trust_score_description: Very Low - Only 1 out of 5 claims has credible scientific backing
